scope: Initial assessment formula for the lighten-robot-shadows skill
summary: The first lightening assessment remained PARTIAL because it compared normalized plate-MAE reduction over candidate-specific active sets and demanded +0.025; gain changes the active set and its denominator, so that formula was not a valid cross-candidate gate.
evidence: shadow-lightening-assessment-v1-rejected-metric.json records reduction gain 0.0090892 and shadow_lighter=false while decode, edit-scope, jerk, protection, motion-configuration, and outside-safety gates pass.
The same render reduces absolute post-cleanup plate MAE from 26.4339 to 25.2723 and increases bounded plate alpha from 0.0076077 to 0.0081118.
No video or parent experiment was overwritten while correcting the assessment contract.
lessons: Do not compare normalized means over moving active-pixel populations as if their denominators were fixed.
Use absolute post-cleanup plate distance together with bounded alpha increase and visual review.
limitations: This record rejects the first metric formula, not necessarily the gain-1.20 pixels.
Human review was still pending at this point.
